occurrences.text: The Lord therefore be judge, and judge between me and thee, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of thine hand.
A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
